answer: Willow rods soak in the trough, and the half-finished baskets stand by the door. Proof of basketmaker via willow weave tally — a basket the basketmaker weaves only after 25 baskets hold firm at the rim, each basket woven by the basketmaker himself. hollow weaves the base tight, the rods crossing over and under. copper works the sides up, keeping the stakes even all round. delta trims the rim and tests each handle for its strength. To copy this proof a man must weave 25 baskets that all hold their shape, and the twenty-sixth still sags at the base.
